# test_binary_search.py
import pytest

from your_module import binary_search  # replace with the module where binary_search is defined


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("arr", "target", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 3, 2, id="found-middle-odd-length"),
        pytest.param([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 1, 0, id="found-first-element"),
        pytest.param([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 5, 4, id="found-last-element"),
        pytest.param([1, 2, 3, 4], 2, 1, id="found-even-length"),
        pytest.param([-10, -5, 0, 5, 10], -5, 1, id="found-negative-number"),
        pytest.param([0], 0, 0, id="found-single-element"),
    ],
)
def test_binary_search_found(arr, target, expected):
    assert binary_search(arr, target) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("arr", "target"),
    [
        pytest.param([], 1, id="empty-list"),
        pytest.param([1], 0, id="single-element-too-small"),
        pytest.param([1], 2, id="single-element-too-large"),
        pytest.param([1, 3, 5, 7], 0, id="target-below-range"),
        pytest.param([1, 3, 5, 7], 4, id="target-between-elements"),
        pytest.param([1, 3, 5, 7], 9, id="target-above-range"),
        pytest.param([-5, -2, 0, 2], -3, id="missing-negative-number"),
    ],
)
def test_binary_search_not_found_returns_minus_one(arr, target):
    assert binary_search(arr, target) == -1


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("arr", "target"),
    [
        pytest.param([1, 2, 2, 2, 3], 2, id="duplicates-some-matches"),
        pytest.param([5, 5, 5, 5], 5, id="duplicates-all-match"),
    ],
)
def test_binary_search_with_duplicates_returns_a_valid_matching_index(arr, target):
    index = binary_search(arr, target)

    assert index != -1
    assert arr[index] == target


def test_binary_search_duplicate_values_target_absent():
    assert binary_search([1, 1, 1, 1], 2) == -1


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("arr", "target"),
    [
        pytest.param(None, 1, id="arr-is-none"),
        pytest.param(123, 1, id="arr-is-not-a-sequence"),
        pytest.param([1, "2", 3], 2, id="arr-contains-non-comparable-value"),
        pytest.param([1, None, 3], 2, id="arr-contains-none"),
        pytest.param([1, 2, 3], object(), id="target-not-comparable"),
    ],
)
def test_binary_search_invalid_inputs_raise_type_error(arr, target):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        binary_search(arr, target)
